newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy market sees modest fall in o/n rate.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy market sees modest fall in o/n rate.

text.p: Italy's money market continues to expect the overnight rate to ease on a one-month horizon, a study by the Bocconi University research arm Igier showed.

The study, based on implicit overnight rates, showed the market saw the overnight rate at 7.25 percent in one month. That is slightly lower than expectations a week ago of 7.3 percent and from the actual market close of 7.38 percent on Thursday, the day Igier based its study.
In three months, the implicit overnight rate is seen at 7.04 percent compared with expectations of 6.97 percent last week and 6.96 last month.
On a one-year horizon, the implicit overnight rate is seen at 6.64 percent, higher than the 6.39 percent seen a week ago and 6.2 percent last month.
In two years, the implicit overnight rate is expected at 6.81 percent, up from 6.62 percent seen last week and 6.25 percent last month.

The spread between the implicit Italian overnight rate and the implicit German overnight rate on a two-year horizon is seen as a good indicator of market confidence in Europe's economic and monetary union. The spread widened to 235 basis points from last week's 223 basis points and 172 basis points last month.
